notes: No constraint is enforced in DuckDB (CTAS tables); every relationship is logical/inferred.
pk lists come from unique_grain tests (dbt/tests/generic/test_unique_grain.sql), QUALIFY/ROW_NUMBER partitions, or GROUP BY; see each entity's evidence.
findings.* columns+types come from tools/dashboard_columns.json (DESCRIBE of the test DuckDB, tools/build_databricks_dashboards.py:1066-1077) and may lag the SQL.
d_* models (dbt/models/databricks_direct) are enabled=false: they are never tables; they render app/direct_sql/*.sql (tools/generate_direct_models.py:21-24).
Review (Opus, b8d2db1): cardinalities in model.md erDiagram re-checked; pk_status marks keys backed by a unique_grain test vs inferred from GROUP BY/ROW_NUMBER.
